c5t21_s87242018: collision at t=3.933 s, robot moving 1.00 m/s, mover_00 at [0.02, -0.67] m (front/right), first unmapped detection at t=0.53 s (1.95 m).
c5t21_s1456705647: collision at t=41.283 s, robot moving 0.42 m/s, mover_03 at [-0.57, 0.48] m (behind/left), first unmapped detection at t=38.35 s (1.99 m).

assumptions.assumption: Moving boxes become tracked (M) before they enter the 3 m safety radius (_SAFE_DIST).
assumptions.why: First unmapped detections in failures occur at ~2 m and sometimes only ~0.5 s before impact, so tracks are created too late.

assumptions.assumption: The VO planner can find a safe (v,w) within _VO_FAIL_T (0.5 s) once a mover is within _SAFE_DIST.
assumptions.why: Collisions happen while VO is active, indicating it often returns None or unsafe commands in the critical window.

assumptions.assumption: Side‑detour points generated by _side_detour are reachable before the mover contacts the robot.
assumptions.why: In collisions the robot never reaches a side detour; the mover arrives from behind while the robot is still rotating or stopped.

assumptions.assumption: When pause_until expires the robot can resume motion instantly without residual rotation.
assumptions.why: Stop‑turn episodes show the robot rotates in place for seconds before collision, delaying forward motion.

approach_families.family: simple pause on close lidar points
VO always on with side‑detour fallback

candidates.idea: Re‑introduce a raw‑TTC pre‑filter: compute TTC from unmapped lidar points and if TTC < 0.8 s issue an immediate stop (pause_until) before VO planning.
candidates.for: covers cases where VO cannot find a command quickly enough; gives a guaranteed safe halt.
candidates.risk: may cause unnecessary stops on noisy points, reducing efficiency.

candidates.idea: Add a rear‑approach backup behavior: when any tracked mover is behind the robot (relative x < ‑0.5 m) and within 1.0 m, command a short reverse (‑0.4 m/s for 0.5 s) using the existing _px_backup_cmd logic, then resume normal planning.
candidates.for: directly addresses collisions from behind observed in three failures.
candidates.risk: risk of backing into static obstacles if map clearance is not re‑checked.

candidates.idea: Lower the clustering thresholds in _perceive (require ≥2 points within 0.6 m instead of 4 points within 0.9 m) to create tracks earlier.
candidates.for: earlier track creation gives VO more time to plan avoidance.
candidates.risk: increased false‑positive tracks from noise may trigger spurious avoidance actions.

diagnosis.chosen: Rear‑approach backup behavior (candidate 2) because collisions consistently involve movers approaching from behind and the current VO side‑detour does not react fast enough.
diagnosis.target: controller (and a small helper function for rear backup)
diagnosis.direction: 1. After _perceive, compute M = _track_array(st, t). 2. Scan M for any mover whose predicted centre (mx, my) satisfies x_rel = mx - pose[0] < -0.5 m and distance < 1.0 m. 3. If such a mover exists, call the existing _px_backup_cmd(st, pose, M, near) to obtain a safe reverse speed v_back. 4. Return (v_back, 0.0, False) after passing it through _guard to ensure lidar‑strip and swept‑body safety. 5. Set st["pause_until"] = t + 0.6 s so the robot stays stopped after the backup. 6. If no rear mover is found, continue with the existing VO‑until logic as before.
